summary_markdown: A discussion arose regarding inconsistencies in data provided in reports, specifically concerning varying levels of granularity (e.g., aggregated vs. minute-by-minute). It was noted that the current discrepancy might be due to different calculation methods or initial requirements for specific reporting needs. A review is needed to ensure consistent data output across all reports and to verify which systems are pulling minute-level data.
decisions: Review required to standardize data granularity in reports.
action_items: Check the source responsible for retrieving minute-by-minute data.
